title: uuencoding/encode.rs: index loop should use .chunks(3)
description:
Why this exists: uuencoding/src/encode.rs uses a while i < chunk.len() loop with manual chunk[i], chunk[i+1], chunk[i+2] indexing to process 3-byte groups. The iterators standard mandates .iter()/.enumerate() over index loops because index loops can panic; iterators cannot go out of bounds.

What goes wrong: chunk[i+1] and chunk[i+2] will panic at runtime if the slice is not a multiple of 3 bytes (the final partial group). The code avoids this by padding, but the correctness depends on the padding logic being right — an off-by-one in the padding leaves a panic path. Using .chunks(3) makes the boundary safe by construction and eliminates the manual index arithmetic entirely.

Fix: replace the while loop with for group in chunk.chunks(3) { ... } and match on group.len() for the partial final chunk.
